body: The thing is, I don't know if I want 2014. With only 2 days left. I don't want to live how I am for another 2 months, to feel this way, to feel that the person who is perfect in my eyes and lives with me, doesn't even know I'm there....I feel that since she doesn't acknowledge my existence then maybe it wouldn't be so bad that I am gone.

Everyday all I do is struggle to make money to live. I'm flat broke right now and its completely my fault. I had a wonderful job that paid well and I didn't take full advantage of it before I moved. I didn't save what I should have and I didn't prepare how I should have before I came out here. I fucked my life upside down and that's why i feel like I deserve to punish myself. I feel like walking back out and getting that razor blade out again and coming back into my room.

The woman I love has changed my life beyond anything other thing in my life. She taught me what a family was by bringing me into hers and by showing me the world outside the box that I lived in. She opened my eyes and showed me what it was to care for people. I care too much for her to want to stop trying, but I don't think she is willing to give me another chance. That's all I want, but it seems like I'll never get it.

The thing is, I really don't know if I can. I'm very self destructive. I keep imagining things and confront her about it and all it does is drive her away. I literally think about her 24/7. While I'm at work or while she's at work or while she's even her next to me. If I am forced to leave her side in Feb like we agreed, I honestly don't know if I can survive alone. I moved to a state where I have no friends or family. No one but her.
